chunks: And it is narrated in another report:
"Whoever trims his nails on Friday should begin with the little finger of the left hand and conclude with the little finger of the right hand."

key_terms.بِخِنْصِرِهِ: with his little finger; referring to starting or ending from it

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended order for trimming nails on Friday in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This report describes a recommended etiquette for trimming the nails on Friday. It specifies the order, beginning with the little finger of the left hand and ending with the little finger of the right hand, reflecting adab connected to cleanliness and Friday observance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.304 - It is also reported in another narration:
"Whoever trims their nails on Jumu’ah should start with the little finger of the left hand and finish with the little finger of the right hand."
